rules.semantics: CW and Phone are separate contests; W/VE sends location, DX sends power as a number or abbreviation; single-band entries retain contacts from other bands; Cabrillo is the official electronic format.

cabrilloHeader.semantics: LOCATION is required for ARRL contests and follows ARRL/RAC section versus DX policy; CATEGORY-TRANSMITTER is required for multi-operator entries; CATEGORY-STATION is optional in this supported SINGLE-OP/ONE preview subset.

cabrilloQSO.semantics: QSO records contain frequency, mode, UTC date and time, both callsigns, reports and six-character exchange templates; sponsors accept space-delimited fields, and transmitter ID is not used for single-operator entries.

adif.semantics: STX_STRING and SRX_STRING preserve exchange text; MY_DXCC and DXCC identify entities; MY_STATE and STATE apply to subdivisions, including ADIF NL for Newfoundland and Labrador.
